the_dominant_vacuity_trap.problem: Uninitialized memory is very often already zero, and many compilers zero-fill. A test asserting x == 0 after INTEGER :: x = 0 proves NOTHING - it passes identically on a processor that ignores initialization entirely. This is the single most dangerous failure mode in this section.
the_dominant_vacuity_trap.rule_enforced: No 0, 0.0, .FALSE. or blank may be used as an initialization value the test expects to observe. Every observed sentinel must be a distinctive non-default value that no plausible wrong implementation would produce.

sentinel_audit.ignoring_initialization_yields: integer zero or undefined; logical false

the_dominant_vacuity_trap.note: The character blank-padding checks are not standalone sentinels; it is the nonblank prefix plus the explicit LEN assertion that makes those cases load-bearing.

non_vacuity_by_mutation.principle: Non-vacuity must be proved by MUTATION targeting the FEATURE UNDER TEST. For initialization the decisive feature-level mutation is REMOVING THE INITIALIZER.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.author_campaign: 95 gfortran mutations all failing, plus 14 initializer-removal mutations all failing, plus a reverse sentinel mutation that passed when matched and failed when removed.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.verdict: Every sampled initializer removal FAILED as required, so no fixture passes with initialization absent.

deliberate_exclusions_judged_correct.false_logical: A .FALSE. initializer was deliberately NOT established: observing false is vacuous under zero or default fill. The reviewer confirmed this is correct restraint, not over-breadth.
deliberate_exclusions_judged_correct.zero_length_character: A length-zero character initializer was deliberately NOT established for runtime effect: the length is declared and no payload remains to observe.
deliberate_exclusions_judged_correct.principle: An unobservability claim that is too broad is itself a defect, so both exclusions were audited rather than accepted; both stand.

lfortran_defects_verified.defect: Pointer initial target is rejected at compile time
lfortran_defects_verified.standard_basis: 8.2 R805 permits initialization '=> initial-data-target'. 7.5.4.6 C770 requires that an initial-data-target designate a nonallocatable, noncoindexed variable with the TARGET and SAVE attributes. 8.4 p2: 'If initial-data-target appears, the object is initially associated with the target.' The fixture target, integer with TARGET and SAVE, satisfies every one of those conditions, and p is a matching integer pointer.
lfortran_defects_verified.frozen_lfortran_0_65_0_411: semantic error: Initialization of 'p' must reduce to a compile time constant

lfortran_defects_verified.standard_basis: 8.6.7 p1: 'The DATA statement specifies explicit initialization (8.4).' 8.6.7 p4: 'Except for variables in named common blocks, a named variable has the SAVE attribute if any part of it is initialized in a DATA statement.' 8.5.16 p1: SAVE retains association, allocation, definition status and value after RETURN or END. So data a(-2) /-12345/ saves the WHOLE named array a, and after the first call a(-2)=-12344 and a(-1)=2468 must be retained.
lfortran_defects_verified.frozen_lfortran_0_65_0_411: compiles, then fails at runtime with stdout 'INIT:data_part_retention:second-retained-initialized-part' and ERROR STOP
lfortran_defects_verified.note: The reviewer was specifically warned that 'a variable in a DATA statement', 'initialization implying SAVE', and 'retention across calls' are DISTINCT claims, and it established the chain through all three rather than asserting retention directly.

source_derivations_independently_confirm.kind_conversion: Supported by 8.4 p1 with 10.2.1.3 and Table 10.9. selected_int_kind(18) is PORTABLE because 7.4.3.1 p2 requires an integer representation range of at least 18; no numeric kind code is assumed to exist, and the default value 2719 is representable.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.character_conversion: Supported by 10.2.1.3 p11: a shorter variable truncates on the right, a longer one pads on the right with blanks. LEN is asserted explicitly.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.scalar_array_expansion: Supported by 10.2.1.3 p5; bounds and every element are asserted.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.derived_override: Supported by the structure-constructor rules: the supplied component 2719 prevents the default -111, which is what distinguishes explicit initialization from default initialization.
